holidays.name: National Hot Sauce Day
holidays.description: Time to give your taste buds a wake-up call. Today is for dousing your eggs, tacos, wings and pizza in your favorite bottle of fiery goodness, from mild and tangy to tears-streaming-down-your-face hot.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin, popular with chiliheads and condiment collectors alike.
holidays.funFact: Spiciness is measured on the Scoville scale, created in 1912 by pharmacist Wilbur Scoville. A jalapeño usually lands between 2,500 and 8,000 Scoville units, while pure capsaicin tops out at 16 million.

holidays.name: National Answer Your Cat's Questions Day
holidays.description: Your cat has been asking you things all along: Why is the bowl not full? Why is that door closed? Why are you sitting on my chair? Today you're encouraged to stop ignoring the meows and give your feline a proper answer.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial, playful observance of unclear origin, popular with cat owners who are sure their pets are talking to them.
holidays.funFact: Adult cats rarely meow at each other. They mostly save meowing for humans, and they seem to have developed it largely to communicate with people.
